description:
Create a multi-step outreach sequence from saved templates. It's saved as an inactive draft: nothing sends until it's activated (spur_set_workflow_active) and owners are enrolled.

Send steps take a saved template: email/SMS from spur_list_message_templates (design new ones with spur_create_email_template / spur_create_sms_template), direct mail from the user's saved postcard or letter templates. Wait steps space them out. Reply/open/click branches can be added afterwards in Spur → Outreach.

Example: "text, wait 2 days, email, wait 5 days, postcard" -> steps=[{type:"send_sms",template_id:…},{type:"wait",days:2},{type:"send_email",template_id:…},{type:"wait",days:5},{type:"send_direct_mail",template_id:…}]

description.description: Optional note about the workflow's goal

steps.description: Steps in run order: send_email / send_sms / send_direct_mail with a saved template_id, and wait steps (days, hours) between them

send_as_reply.description: Reply in the previous email's thread

template_id.description: Email template id (UUID from a Spur list/search tool)
